title: Miso Tuna Gunkan
description: A compact tuna-mayo topping enriched with a small amount of white miso.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Simmer mirin briefly and dissolve the white miso into it. Cool completely.
Combine the miso mixture with drained tuna and Kewpie. Fold through sliced scallions.
Form rice into approximately 24 small ovals and wrap each with a nori strip taller than the rice.
Spoon the tuna mixture into each nori cup just before serving.
notes: Different white miso brands have different salt levels; taste before adding anything salty.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
